# Security Policy

## Supported Versions

| Version | Supported          |
| ------- | ------------------ |
| 1.0.x   | :white_check_mark: |

## Reporting a Vulnerability

We take the security of TrolleyWise UK seriously.

If you discover a security vulnerability, please do NOT open a public issue. Instead, please report it directly by email or via GitHub Private Vulnerability Reporting to `@knowlesy`.

Please include:
1. Description of the vulnerability.
2. Steps or proof-of-concept to reproduce the issue.
3. Potential impact and attack vectors.

We will acknowledge receipt of your vulnerability report within 48 hours and provide an estimated timeline for remediation.
